Let me draft with propose_change_set as the only tool call.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_Lmdry0IFB5j0HLeOJ5rN2137","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "\nimport { fetch } from \"zttp:fetch\";\nimport { schemaCompile, validateObject } from \"zttp:validate\";\n\nschemaCompile(\"cityQuery\", JSON.stringify({\n  type: \"object\",\n  required: [\"city\"],\n  properties: {\n    city: { type: \"string\", minLength: 1, maxLength: 64 }\n  }\n}));\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"fault_covered\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n  const checked = validateObject(\"cityQuery\", { city: req.query[\"city\"] });\n  if (!checked.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing or invalid city query parameter\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  const upstream = fetch(\"https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast\", {\n    query: { city: checked.value[\"city\"] },\n    maxResponseBytes: 65536\n  });\n  if (!upstream.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"weather service unavailable\" }, { status: 502 });\n  }\n  return Response.json(upstream.json());\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":23652,"completion_tokens":1166,"total_tokens":24818,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":4992},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":716},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":4992,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":18660},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
